document.lead: You should spend about 20 minutes on this task.

chart.alt: Cycle diagram in 6 stages (The life cycle of a frog). 1: eggs are laid in water; 2: tadpoles hatch after 10 days; 3: back legs grow (6 weeks); 4: front legs grow and the tail shrinks; 5: a young frog leaves the water; 6: the adult frog lays eggs; then the cycle starts again.
